verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents its own OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages APIs, which it describes as compatible with Claude clients. It also documents tool/function calling with automatic tool-call format detection. Together these are the backend surfaces a coding agent would use, but no evidence shows a coding agent actually configured and working against LocalAI. missing for 10: documented setup for a specific coding agent (e.g., a Claude-style or OpenAI-based coding CLI) pointed at LocalAI, evidence that agentic coding loops work reliably with tool calls against local models, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend

citations.quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
LocalAI supports the Anthropic Messages API, which is compatible with Claude clients.
No configuration required - the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support.
Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
